Latest figures from the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) showed that cash outside banks eased from N5.21 trillion recorded in January and dropped notably from the N5.40 trillion peak in December 2025. In the same vein, currency […]

Sabuwar bayani daga Bankin Tarayya na Najeriya (CBN) ya nuna cewa kuɗi na wajen banki ya ragu daga naira triliyunan 5.21 da aka gida a Januweriyar zuwa raguwa mai mahimmanci daga kuɗin naira triliyunan 5.40 da aka ji a watan Disembur 2025.
